answer: A desert oasis keeps one water ledger per agent. Each epoch the keeper fills a crystal vial at the spring, seals it with a wax mark, and ties it to a raven that flies one fixed route to the registrar. The registrar weighs the vial, checks the seal against the spring log, and files the weight; a refilled vial weighs wrong and a forged seal fails the log. A raven carries one vial per flight and the flight takes 40 minutes, so a thousand fake names need a thousand vials, a thousand seals, and a thousand raven flights, 40,000 minutes of bird time.
